product.title: Los Cabos Luxury Sunset Sail with Light Appetizers and Open Bar

description.text: In Cabo San Lucas, this small-group sunset sail leaves the marina on a 50-foot boat for Land's End, Lover's Beach, and the Arch of Cabo San Lucas. An open bar of sparkling wine, cocktails, beer, and soft drinks is served with light appetizers so the evening stays on the water rather than a separate restaurant stop. The crew handles docking and pacing while the published route stays on the bay and rock formations that mark where the Sea of Cortez meets the Pacific. Hotel pickup is listed for many Los Cabos properties. The format suits visitors who want a guided scenic evening without chartering a boat independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Cabo San Lucas, and the itinerary stays on the marina, Lover's Beach, and Arch that define this sunset outing.
